source.title: Call for Applicants - WCA Software Team Leader (May 2025)
source.content:
The WCA is calling for applications trom suitable individuals to lead the WCA Software Team (WST). The current leader, Gregor Billing was appointed to the role in June 2021 and has served two consecutive 24 month terms. The WCA thanks Gregor for his exemplary leadership during this time.  As Gregor’s role cannot be renewed for an additional term, an open-election is required as per the [WCA Motion 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). Gregor is permitted to reapply. 


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 10 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:


Strong technical expertise (including experience with tools, frameworks and platforms used by the WCA e.g. GitHub, React, NextJS etc)

* Exceptional communication skills

* Problem solving skills

* High level of trustworthiness and responsiveness

* Project management experience

* Strong leadership skills
<!-- break -->

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents **until June 1st, 2025, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates should send their application to the Executive Assistants Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org). 


**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

1. Brief personal introduction.

2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.

3. Ambitions as the WST Leader of the WCA.


Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.


The rights and duties of the WST can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2024.11](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.11%20-%20Software%20Team.pdf).


After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of[ WCA Motion 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).


Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: 招募 WCA 软件组负责人（2025 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 现面向符合条件的人选招募 WCA 软件组（WST）负责人。现任负责人 Gregor Billing 于 2021 年 6 月上任，已连续任职两届，每届 24 个月。感谢 Gregor 在此期间出色的领导工作。根据 [WCA 议案 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)，Gregor 不能直接续任下一届，因此须公开选举。Gregor 可以再次申请。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 10 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下能力和素质：

扎实的技术能力，包括使用 WCA 相关工具、框架和平台的经验，例如 GitHub、React、NextJS 等。

* 出色的沟通能力。
* 解决问题的能力。
* 值得信赖，能及时回应事务。
* 项目管理经验。
* 较强的领导能力。

申请截止时间为 **2025 年 6 月 1 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者请将申请材料发送至董事会助理团队（assistants@worldcubeassociation.org），并抄送董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
3. 担任 WCA 软件组负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WST 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2024.11](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.11%20-%20Software%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 议案 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，投票选出并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
